rows.medi_said: Okay, so isn't it en-enbistee? Did you enjoy? ... I put enbustee.
rows.amal_said: "انبسطتي." ... I guess in the past ... Yes, it is double T.
rows.why: Past 'you (f) enjoyed' needs the -ti ending on the past stem (انبسط + تي = انبسطتي); he dropped the past-tense t (enbistee = انبستي) and said at 07:03 he thought the t was removed; Amal recast انبسطتي and confirmed 'it is double T'; he admits 'I just forgot the double T'.
rows.english: Did you enjoy your time outside?

rows.medi_said: Did you enjoy, past tense, your time outside? Okay, so isn't it en-enbistee?
rows.amal_said: what is it-- what is missing? It's not "انبسطتي." Something is missing. What is it? ... "في" or be?
rows.why: انبسط takes في / بـ before the thing enjoyed (sheet: 'have fun / enjoy | Enbese6 (fi | انبسط'); his homework sentence had no preposition, Amal prompted 'what is missing?' and he found it: 'The في, I totally forgot', then 07:56 انبسطتي في وقتك.
rows.english: Did you enjoy your time outside?

rows.english: Camping made everyone happy and excited.

rows.english: Camping made everyone happy and excited.
